candidates.explanation: The confirm-new-email mail builds its link with the '/confirm-email' path, which is the sign-up activation page. That page calls the confirmEmail endpoint, not confirmNewEmail, so the email change is never confirmed. The link should point to '/confirm-new-email'.

fix.description: Change the URL path in confirmNewEmail from '/confirm-email' to '/confirm-new-email'.
